# A6c results (generated by rc100_qi.py; do not edit)

Editorial analysis. Main fits propagate the journal Vc and Re errors, assuming zero covariance. The ±0.5 correlations are illustrative sensitivity choices, not measurements. Likelihood scores and profile intervals are conditional on this approximate error model; bootstrap fractions are not posterior probabilities or calibrated p-values.

Validation on Sentina's table as transcribed (McGaugh function): constant-scale A = 1.288 × 10⁻¹⁰ m s⁻², Δ(−ln L) of H(z) relative to constant = 8.98. Sentina reports 1.26 (bootstrap median) and 8.98.
